summary: GRI 11 provides information for organizations in the oil and gas sector about their likely material topics, based on the sector's most significant impacts on the economy, environment, and people. It lists disclosures to report for each topic, drawn from the GRI Topic Standards and other sources.

questions.text: At which operation locations are Indigenous Peoples present or affected by the organization's activities?

questions.text: Has the organization been involved in a process of seeking free, prior, and informed consent (FPIC) from Indigenous Peoples for any of its activities? For each case, was the process mutually accepted and has an agreement been reached?
questions.hint: Topic 11.17 additional sector disclosure. Report if involved in an FPIC process, and for each case: a. whether the process was mutually accepted by the organization and the affected Indigenous Peoples; b. whether an agreement was reached and, if so, whether it is publicly available.
